global_style: High-fashion, glossy urban aesthetic; smooth continuous tracking; seamless match-cut transformations; kinetic edit rhythm driven by heel clicks and pulsing music.

style_overrides.color_palette: sleek monochrome with dark green, white, black accents
style_overrides.architecture: dense New York urban streetscape, contemporary signage, yellow cabs

key_events: Andy power-walks along a bustling Manhattan street in a single smooth tracking shot.
Passing behind a yellow taxi triggers a seamless outfit change to a white tweed look with thigh-high Chanel boots.
Passing behind a narrow streetlamp triggers a second seamless change to a sleek black evening jacket.
The paper coffee cup remains perfectly aligned in her hand through all transitions; heel clicks and music drive momentum.
narrative_context.cultural_context: Urban fashion-as-performance, Manhattan street-as-runway sensibility; brand-conscious styling and music-video pacing emphasize confidence and transformation.

characters.name: Andy
characters.description: Fashion-forward woman in her 20s–30s, confident posture, decisive stride, polished grooming; carries a paper coffee cup; aura of control; high heels clicking underscore her presence.
characters.clothing_style: High-fashion outerwear transformations: heavy dark green double-breasted coat; white tweed coat with thigh-high Chanel boots; sleek tailored black evening jacket. Polished, runway-ready styling.
characters.voice_description: Confident, crisp, modern New York edge; poised and deliberate.
characters.personality: Dominant, self-assured, stylish, relentless, focused; treats the city like her runway; unfazed by chaos; enjoys precise control and continuity.
characters.backstory: A high-powered, style-savvy figure in Manhattan whose presence turns sidewalks into runways; accustomed to commanding attention.
characters.current_motivation: Project unwavering confidence and control while showcasing seamless high-fashion transformations without breaking stride.

locations.name: Manhattan Street
locations.visual_style: Bustling Manhattan avenue; constant foot and car traffic; yellow taxi; narrow streetlamp; smooth lateral tracking; glossy, high-fashion sheen; seamless transition points; urban soundscape of heel clicks, engines, and music.
locations.narrative_function: Runway-like urban path enabling seamless outfit transformations in a single tracking shot.

props.visual_description: Heavy dark green double-breasted overcoat with structured shoulders; mid-thigh length; dramatic movement as she strides.

props.name: White Tweed Coat
props.visual_description: Chic white tweed coat with a tailored silhouette; textured weave; luminous, elevated fashion look for the transformation beat.

props.name: Thigh-High Chanel Boots
props.visual_description: Thigh-high black Chanel boots with sleek leather finish and high heel; luxury detail accenting the white tweed look.
